subject: french
title: Numbers 0 to 20
welcome_lead: Count from zero to twenty in French.

walkthroughs.body_html: Un, deux, trois, quatre, cinq, six, sept, huit, neuf, dix. Practice saying these out loud daily.
The teens have their own names: onze, douze, treize, quatorze, quinze, seize (11-16). Learn them as a chunk.
From 17 they switch to 'ten-seven' style: dix-sept (17), dix-huit (18), dix-neuf (19), vingt (20).

options: As a nasal vowel - the n is not fully pronounced.
